body: QWEN CHAT DISCORD Introduction The evolution of multimodal large models is continually pushing the boundaries of what we believe technology can achieve. From the initial QwenVL to the latest Qwen2.5 VL, we have made progress in enhancing the model’s ability to understand image content. Today, we are excited to introduce a new model, Qwen VLo, a unified multimodal understanding and generation model. This newly upgraded model not only “understands” the world but also generates high-quality recreations based on that understanding, truly bridging the gap between perception and creation.
summaryZh: 通义千问团队今日正式推出Qwen VLo，这是一个全新的统一多模态理解与生成模型。该模型在以往QwenVL和Qwen2.5 VL强大的图像理解能力基础之上进行了重大升级，不仅能够准确“理解”现实世界的图像内容，还能基于这种理解生成高质量的再创作图像，真正实现了视觉感知与创意的有机融合。

glossary.explanationZh: 多模态，指能够同时处理文本、图像等多种不同数据类型的大模型技术。
视觉感知，指模型对图像中物体、场景及语义的解析与理解能力。
生成模型，指能够根据条件或输入创造新图像、文本等内容的模型。
